text: They cried out to You and were delivered; They trusted in You and were not disappointed or ashamed.
"He trusted and committed himself to the LORD, let Him save him. Let Him rescue him, because He delights in him."
I was cast upon You from birth; From my mother's womb You have been my God.
They divide my clothing among them And cast lots for my garment.
Save me from the lion's mouth; From the horns of the wild oxen You answer me.
For He has not despised nor detested the suffering of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from him; But when he cried to Him for help, He listened.
They will come and declare His righteousness To a people yet to be born—that He has done it [and that it is finished].
